purpose: Expand familiar everyday vocabulary, without replacing ordinary words with obscure filler merely to obtain board fits.
method: Exclude all previously reviewed spellings. Inspect dictionary senses individually. Test independent seven-tile five-answer layouts against the 2,160 approved words, including 85 awaiting integration. Twenty-five candidates have valid examples with four already-approved partners and at least one unused approval. For the other 25, the bounded search found no example; that is not proof of impossibility.
limitations: Owner approved 35 and rejected 15; none of this batch is integrated into active revision 28 yet. Compatibility figures describe the original 50-candidate proposal, not only the approved subset. Independent examples do not establish joint 75-level spacing, pacing, extension capacity or repetition.
sourceAttribution: Individual dictionary URLs and content hashes retained. Brief English glosses only; full source definitions are not republished.
